en.headline: Hong Kong Palace Museum opens Eastern Orthodox art exhibition tomorrow
en.dek: About 100 icon paintings and treasures from Russia’s State Tretyakov Gallery go on display in Gallery 9 from 21 October until March 2027.
body: The Hong Kong Palace Museum opens a special exhibition of Eastern Orthodox art tomorrow, featuring about 100 icon paintings and gemstone-encrusted treasures spanning nearly a millennium.

The exhibition, titled Windows into Heaven, draws works from the State Tretyakov Gallery in Russia and runs in Gallery 9 until 26 March 2027. It traces the evolution of Eastern Orthodox art and the role of visual narratives related to Christ, the Virgin Mary, saints and the Bible.

Admission to the relevant galleries is HK$180 for a flex entry ticket or HK$150 for a timed entry ticket. The museum is open 10am to 6pm on Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday, and until 8pm on Friday, Saturday and public holidays, and is closed on Tuesdays except public holidays.
The Hong Kong Palace Museum is presenting the show as part of its 2026 programme of exhibitions that also include collaborations with other international institutions.

zh.headline: 香港故宮明日開展東正教藝術展
zh.dek: 約100件來自俄羅斯特列季亞科夫美術館的聖像畫及珍寶，將於9號展廳展出至2027年3月。
body: 香港故宮文化博物館明日開展一場東正教藝術特別展覽，展出約100件跨越近千年的聖像畫及鑲嵌寶石珍寶。
展覽名為「天堂之窗」，作品來自俄羅斯特列季亞科夫美術館，於9號展廳展出至2027年3月26日。展覽追溯東正教藝術的演變，以及與基督、聖母、聖人及聖經相關的視覺敘事。
相關展廳入場費為彈性門票180元或定時門票150元。博物館周一、三、四及周日上午十時至下午六時開放，周五、六及公眾假期至晚上八時，周二閉館（公眾假期除外）。
香港故宮文化博物館將此展覽列入2026年展覽計劃，同期亦有與其他國際機構合作的項目。
